propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false (evidence-of-absence) when it should bank insufficient_evidence (search budget exhausted without determination)

The evidence banking write path (fallback_record, CriterionBank.upsert, record_criterion_verdict, harvest_structured_into_bank) uses bool-only types and must become tri-state (met: true, met: false, insufficient_evidence)

Verdict rendering seams (assemble_deterministic_verdict, merge_finalizer_with_bank) and the close gate must distinguish insufficient_evidence from unmet criteria, rendering INDETERMINATE with remediation guidance instead of FAIL

The completion_verdict schema must expand criteria[].met to boolean|null with optional state enum, and top-level verdict must gain INDETERMINATE token; backward compatibility with existing all-bool records is required

Round-trip persistence through harvest and sidecar must preserve tri-state entries; reconcile_verdict must pass INDETERMINATE through unconverted on all code paths (completion.py, gate_ops.py, completion_sidecar.py)
Close gate still blocks on insufficient_evidence (fail-closed) but reports remediation guidance (re-run, widen scope, operator-attest) instead of asserting the criterion affirmatively failed
